alterations.description: Lines from the song 'O Gandhi ko beto o Nehru ke chclo... Ki karze men hai baal baal aajkal, uthata hai dasto sawal aajkal' (Sound only) and the underlined word from the line 'Yehan aat bhook aur mengai hai'.
Dialogue of the servant addressed to Meena: 'Naukar to usi din mar jata hai jis din wo kişi ki naukari karta bai'.
Shots of college professors made to look ridiculous or comical, retaining only a few shots for continuity.
Replacement of shots of college professors made to look ridiculous or comical with approved shots.
Reference to 'Paighambar' in the dialogue between the grandfather and a Muslim employee who is shown to be indulging goonda tactics.
Removal of the incorrect map of India in the background during the picturisation of the song 'Aao logo tumhen sunaoon...' and replacement with approved shots.

Deletion of underlined words from the lines 'Kistarah banjaayen lakhpati sabse ke - yahi mansubo, Şabko apna ghar bharna hai desh bhalo bi dube' (Sound) and replacement with approved words (sound only).
Remarks from the prosecuting lawyer's arguments in court that cast aspersions on the honesty of people in general and the business community in particular.

film_title: Trailer of Hum Kahan Ja Rahe Hain

alterations.description: Opening shots of portraits of Mahatma Gandhi and Pandit Nehru superimposed by titles replaced with approved shots.
Shots of college students ridiculing a professor and making sounds like 'Tur... tur...'.
Close shots of the Marwari money-lender in which he is made to look revolting and ridiculous.
Murli's dialogue enumerating the virtues of drinking when Shankar is persuaded by him to take a drink.
Shot of Shankar actually spitting out blood.
Shots of Ramesh whipping Shankar and flash close-ups of his blood-stained face.
Shots of Shankar bleeding profusely from head and face, deleting close-ups of blood-stained back of his head.
Flash shots of Taabai lying in a pool of blood after she is shot by Ramesh (inked off).
Flash close-ups of the blood-stained neck of Ramesh.
Shots showing soliciting and the accompanying dialogue between Marwin and a girl.
From Elizabeth Ashley's talk to Segal, the sentence: 'Wo ll find out if we have anything going for us, besides sex'.
Shots of passionate kissing between Ashley and Segal.
Various portions of the commentary considered likely to contravene the spirit of the Tashkent Agreement, including references to Pakistan and its rulers.
Shots of Indian army men sitting at tea replaced with approved shots.

film_title: Trailer of the Amorous Adventures of Moll Flanders

alterations.description: Indecorous view of Moll Flanders lying on bed and shot of her winking.
Passionate kiss and dialogue between the elder brother and Moll regarding what would happen if Moll doesn't.
From commentary the words '. . . . . . . . . . . . One bridal night with an understandably impetuous groom' and shots of the banker hastily removing his clothing.
From commentary the phrase 'through hardly her first adventure' in reference to Jemmy.

View of the banker looking expectantly from the pillow and commentary '. . . . . . . . . . . the charged expectancy of George Sanders, the wealthy banker who taught Moll the value of her hidden assets'.
From commentary the words '. . . . the wench with an eye strictly for the carriage trade' and the picking of the jewelled stickpin by Moll.
Shot of Moll lifting a bolt of lace.
Various scenes added.
Various scenes deleted.
Song 'Jhankaro Jhankaro'.
Song 'Dushmano savdhan'.
The rough treatment meted out to Ali.
The view of a young girl undressing near the window.
The underlined words from the sentence spoken by Rocco in the bar: 'She is German, tall - sort of a muscleman type'.
The following sentence said by Rocco to Mimi: '. . . and make love in colored sheets'.
The near views of a belly dancer and the indecorous shot of her bosom.
The fight scene consistent with continuity and by removing the vicious blows with boxers.
Shots of soliciting and the accompanying dialogue beginning with the words: 'Oh, come on baby...' upto 'forty dollars'.
